metadata.description: Engineering standards as Claude Code plugins, organised by delivery phase and language — skills, task agents and routing hooks.

plugins.name: ai-toolkit-docs
plugins.description: Language-neutral documentation — ADRs and docs-as-code, UML/Mermaid diagrams, and project context templates with a validator.

plugins.name: ai-toolkit-java
plugins.description: Java 21 / Spring Boot — installs the whole Java toolkit: design, build, quality and ops skills plus the neutral workflow, docs and quality plugins. Task agents (`ai-toolkit-java-agents`) and the repo scaffolder (`ai-toolkit-java-scaffold`) stay optional.

plugins.name: ai-toolkit-java-agents
plugins.description: Java task agents that compose the Java skills — new endpoint, feature, Kafka consumer, metric, client, validation, refactor, code review, repo scaffold, context update, and the parallel test-writer worker. Requires the java-* plugins.

plugins.name: ai-toolkit-java-build
plugins.description: Java 21 / Spring Boot implementation phase — exceptions, validation, permissions, persistence, messaging, external clients, resilience, security and privacy.

plugins.name: ai-toolkit-java-design
plugins.description: Java 21 / Spring Boot design phase — package structure, strategy/registry, ports and adapters, domain modeling, Spring conventions and REST API design. Ships the Java routing hook. Part of the `ai-toolkit-java` set — install that to get the whole language.

plugins.name: ai-toolkit-java-ops
plugins.description: Java 21 / Spring Boot build-and-run phase — Jenkins and GitHub Actions CI, Helm CD, observability, request metrics, health indicators, graceful shutdown, local dev.

plugins.name: ai-toolkit-java-quality
plugins.description: Java 21 / Spring Boot quality phase — unit/component/integration/contract tests, static analysis, quality review and refactoring playbook.

plugins.name: ai-toolkit-java-scaffold
plugins.description: Java 21 / Spring Boot new-repository scaffolding — project-type selection and the create-repo scaffolder.

plugins.name: ai-toolkit-python
plugins.description: Experimental — Python 3.12 / FastAPI — installs the whole Python toolkit: design, build, quality and ops skills plus the neutral workflow, docs and quality plugins. Task agents (`ai-toolkit-python-agents`) stay optional.

plugins.name: ai-toolkit-python-agents
plugins.description: Experimental — Python task agents that compose the python-* skills — new endpoint, feature, refactor, code review and the parallel test-writer worker. Requires the python-* plugins.

plugins.name: ai-toolkit-python-build
plugins.description: Experimental — Python 3.12 / FastAPI build phase — typed errors with problem+json, pydantic validation and SQLAlchemy 2.0 persistence.

plugins.name: ai-toolkit-python-design
plugins.description: Experimental — Python 3.12 / FastAPI design phase — src layout, layering, dependency injection, settings and REST conventions; ships the Python routing hook. Part of the `ai-toolkit-python` set — install that to get the whole language.

plugins.name: ai-toolkit-python-ops
plugins.description: Experimental — Python ops phase — GitHub Actions with uv, hardened Dockerfile, structlog, OpenTelemetry and Prometheus observability.

plugins.name: ai-toolkit-python-quality
plugins.description: Experimental — Python quality phase — pytest unit and integration tests, ruff and mypy static analysis.

plugins.name: ai-toolkit-quality
plugins.description: Language-neutral definition of done — the completion gate (build, tests, static analysis, standards, coverage, Sonar, no commit until asked), code hygiene (no needless comments, dead code or redundant tests) and the Sonar quality gate.

plugins.name: ai-toolkit-react-native
plugins.description: Experimental — React Native — installs the whole React Native toolkit: design, build, quality and ops skills plus the neutral workflow, docs and quality plugins. Task agents (`ai-toolkit-react-native-agents`) stay optional.

plugins.name: ai-toolkit-react-native-agents
plugins.description: Experimental — React Native task agents that compose the react-native-* skills — new screen, feature, refactor, code review and the parallel test-writer worker. Requires the react-native-* plugins.

plugins.name: ai-toolkit-react-native-build
plugins.description: Experimental — React Native build phase: typed error handling, schema-based input validation and mobile security.

plugins.name: ai-toolkit-react-native-design
plugins.description: Experimental — React Native design phase: feature-based code structure, server/client state and data layer, plus the React Native routing hook. Part of the `ai-toolkit-react-native` set — install that to get the whole language.

plugins.name: ai-toolkit-react-native-ops
plugins.description: Experimental — React Native ops phase: GitHub Actions CI with EAS or Fastlane, plus Sentry observability.

plugins.name: ai-toolkit-react-native-quality
plugins.description: Experimental — React Native quality phase: Jest and RNTL unit tests, static analysis gates and Maestro E2E.

plugins.name: ai-toolkit-workflow
plugins.description: Language-neutral delivery workflow — Conventional Commits, PR descriptions, release versioning and parallel delegation to subagents. Works with any stack; install it everywhere.
